summary: Completed comprehensive testing of iter 220d per-machine work reports feature. All 11 backend pytest tests pass. All 20 regression tests (iter 220c autosave + iter 220 custom fields) pass. Frontend UI verified: Machines card displays on Complete tab with empty state, Add machine button, machine rows with serviced/cleaned chips, notes textarea, quick-add note preset palette with pinned presets sorting to top, copy-down button, and delete functionality.
seed_data_creation: Created test machines via API: BikeErg #1, BikeErg #2, BikeErg #3. Created test note presets for dedupe verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 220d per-machine reports feature is fully functional. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_iter_220d_per_machine_reports.py cover CRUD, copy-down, asset snapshot, and note preset dedupe. Frontend WorkVisitMachinesCard.js and NotePresetChips.js components are working correctly. All data-testid attributes are in place for automated testing.

backend_per_machine_crud.details: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/svc/engineer/jobs/{case_id}/machines all working with proper org isolation. 11 pytest cases pass.

copy_down_behaviour.details: POST /machines/{id}/copy-down with fields=[serviced,cleaned,notes] correctly propagates to rows with order_index > source. Tested: updated 2 rows when copying from row 1 to rows 2 and 3.

asset_snapshot.details: Asset picker dropdown shows available equipment. Selecting an asset auto-populates manufacturer/model/serial fields.

note_preset_dedupe.details: POSTing same text twice returns SAME preset id with use_count bumped (1 -> 2). Pinned presets sort to top of list.

frontend_machines_card.details: Machines card appears on Complete tab with empty state message, Add machine button, and proper data-testid attributes.

add_machine_flow.details: Clicking Add machine creates new row (auto-expanded). Machine name input, Serviced/Cleaned chips, Notes textarea all functional.

quick_add_chip_palette.details: Quick-add notes palette visible below Notes textarea. Save as Shared/Personal buttons work. Chips appear after saving. Search box present.

copy_down_ui.details: 'Apply to rows below' button visible on machine rows. Copy-down propagates serviced/cleaned/notes to subsequent rows.

delete_machine.details: Remove button visible on each row. Delete API returns 200 and removes machine from list.

regression_autosave.details: Iter 220c autosave still works - draft PUT/GET endpoints functional. 6 pytest tests pass.

regression_custom_fields.details: Iter 220 custom fields page (/svc/engineer/work-report-fields) API endpoints working. 14 pytest tests pass.
